abstract: A case of sweat gland carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma in a 63-year-old woman is reported. The patient was admitted with the complaint of a lower abdominal pain. Under the diagnosis of a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, the tumor was removed. Histologically, adenocarcinoma was found in the wall of the mature cystic teratoma. A part of the tumor showed a differentiation of the secretory portion and duct of the sweat gland. Histochemically, sialic acid containing mucoprotein was defected. Electron microscopically, the tumor cells were found to have secretory granules and intracytoplasmic canaliculi. Therefore, the tumor was diagnosed as a sweat gland carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 63歳女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した汗腺癌の1例を報告する。患者は下腹部痛を主訴に入院した。右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断で腫瘍を摘出した。組織学的には、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の壁に腺癌が認められた。腫瘍の一部では汗腺の分泌部および導管への分化が示された。組織化学的に、シアル酸含有ムコタンパク質が欠損していた。電子顕微鏡では、腫瘍細胞に分泌顆粒と細胞質内小管が認められた。以上より、本腫瘍は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する汗腺癌と診断された。
